title: Lead triage
description: Go through new emails from people the owner hasn't written to before, pick out the ones asking to work with the business, keep them as leads and draft a reply to each

settings.LOOK_BACK_HOURS: how far back to look at new emails each run, in hours
settings.SKIP: addresses or domains that are never leads
settings.REPLY: the reply to a new lead, in the owner's voice; {name} and {subject} are filled in
settings.SEND: send the reply (true) or keep it as a draft for the owner (false)
